annotation.title_clean: Decision of the EEA Joint Committee No 142/2023 of 28 April 2023 amending Annex XIII (Transport) to the EEA Agreement
annotation.title_en: Decision of the EEA Joint Committee No 142/2023 of 28 April 2023 amending Annex XIII (Transport) to the EEA Agreement
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (EEA Section)
named_instruments_referenced: EU Implementing Regulation 2019/947 on unmanned aircraft operations
annotation.summary_en: EEA Joint Committee decision incorporating Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/525, which corrects language versions of the unmanned aircraft (drone) operation rules in Regulation 2019/947, into Annex XIII (Transport) of the EEA Agreement. It makes the Icelandic and Norwegian texts authentic.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/525 to point 66zbc of Annex XIII of the EEA Agreement
Icelandic and Norwegian language versions are authentic
Enters into force 29 April 2023 or on entry into force of Decision 115/2023, whichever is later
Extends EU drone operation rules (Regulation 2019/947) to EEA EFTA states
